design: Ordinary default-workspace cargo +ohm build and cargo +ohm test --no-run, --locked --offline added. Per endpoint, shuffle three copies of all six permutations of the three subjects. Each of 18 blocks contains one uninstrumented invocation per subject. Apply the complete real edit only in a benchmark worktree. Independently warm all three targets, train each edit direction, and restore the original source with exact index checks and a successful build between edits.
gates: Require a successful next fully fresh Cargo command after every measured edit. Independently record full versus link-only rustcs, every linker process, and authenticated hit/miss logs using tracing outside timing at the first and last edits. Keep the full ELF roster, plus exact-input shadow links for purported hits. A failed gate is unscored.
tests: Contrast the feature-enabled candidate with the shipped and the source-matched binary on each of the two endpoints. Condition on the third subject's position within each block, and enumerate all 8000 assignments that exchange candidate and control while retaining the balanced six permutations. Use the mean log ratio, two-sided exact p-values and Holm correction across all four contrasts at family alpha 0.05. Report a within-order stratified 20000-resample percentile interval.
miss_control: Run a separate fixed 12-pair candidate versus source-matched parent using the full restored Pydantic change, patch SHA256 467330a56398032bfaed34cca5a89ed7de1a6459ddb95756180b16de69b912b1. Seed 1729033. Report overhead and its interval separately from the designated wins. For default activation seek an upper 95 percent bound below a 2 percent time increase on this genuine-miss workload. Repeat the proof and freshness checks on the earlier comment-only workload outside the primary family.
scope: Substantive IDE and Pydantic edits can affect different products; qualify each separately. Do not score the old linker prototype, the stale-timestamp experiment or same-input shadow runs.
